newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds steady but quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds steady but quiet.

text.p: Higher Chicago futures at the end of last week supported UK meals and feeds prices on Monday, but buyer stayed away.
High protein soymeal was up around two to three stg a tonne mainly on the higher Chicago closed and a weaker sterling.
"People have no reason to buy, the market is very quiet,' said one broker.
Others said there was little point in approaching compounds at the moment.
"Compounds not interest because there is no demand from farmers." said another broker.
